newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-INJURED DESAILLY TO MISS FRANCE-TURKEY FRIENDLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INJURED DESAILLY TO MISS FRANCE-TURKEY FRIENDLY.

text.p: Defender Marcel Desailly pulled out of France's soccer friendly against Turkey at the Parc des Princes with a painful calf injury on Tuesday.

The AC Milan player, who had joined the French squad reluctantly, decided to sit out Wednesday's match after suffering serious pains in training. He returned to Milan for further checks, doctors said.
Desailly is the latest in a long list of injured French internationals.

Libero Alain Roche pulled out of the squad on Monday. Goalkeeper Bernard Lama, defenders Bruno N'Gotty and Bixente Lizarazu, strikers Nicolas Ouedec, Christophe Dugarry and Florian Maurice are all unavailable through injury.
